meetings.title: Met at Annual Institutional Forum
meetings.summary: Lakemont College Endowment Fund's Mary Brooks and Sofia Schmidt met with WTW's Mary Mitchell to discuss their current investment strategies. They reviewed the Capital Group Emerging Markets Debt strategy and discussed potential adjustments based on recent market trends.

decisions.text: Continue with the Capital Group Emerging Markets Debt strategy but consider diversifying into other emerging markets debt funds for risk mitigation.

action_items.text: Prepare a follow-up deck highlighting potential adjustments to the Capital Group Emerging Markets Debt strategy.
Review market trends and prepare a report on diversification options for emerging markets debt funds.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Mary Mitchell
transcript_excerpt.text: I think we should consider diversifying into other emerging markets debt funds to mitigate risk.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Mary Brooks
transcript_excerpt.text: That's a good idea. Let's look at the current market trends and see how they might impact our strategy.

meetings.title: On-site portfolio review
meetings.summary: The meeting was held to conduct an on-site portfolio review for the Lakemont College Endowment Fund. Mary Mitchell, representing the fund's fixed income department, presented the current portfolio performance and discussed potential strategies moving forward. Mary Brooks and Sofia Schmidt, key decision-makers from the investment team, provided feedback and highlighted areas of concern. They also expressed interest in peer benchmarking data to better understand market positioning.

decisions.text: Request peer benchmarking data for Lakemont College Endowment Fund's portfolio

action_items.text: Prepare and present the requested peer benchmarking data by end of next week

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Mary Mitchell
transcript_excerpt.text: Thank you all for joining us today. I'd like to start by reviewing our current portfolio performance and discussing any potential strategies moving forward.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Mary Brooks
transcript_excerpt.text: I think it's important that we look at how our portfolio stacks up against our peers. Can we get some benchmarking data?

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Sofia Schmidt
transcript_excerpt.text: Absolutely, Mary. We should also review the risk profile and ensure it aligns with our overall investment strategy.

meetings.title: Pension consultant conference
meetings.summary: The meeting with Lakemont College Endowment Fund was held to discuss the current status of their investment portfolio and explore potential opportunities for growth. The participants discussed recent market trends, strategies for diversification, and the role of emerging markets debt in their overall investment strategy.

decisions.text: Continue with the existing Capital Group Emerging Markets Debt mandate.
Explore new opportunities in alternative investments to enhance portfolio diversification.

action_items.text: Prepare a detailed report on potential alternative investment options.
Schedule a follow-up meeting to review the alternative investment report and discuss next steps.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Mary Mitchell
transcript_excerpt.text: I think we should continue with the Capital Group Emerging Markets Debt mandate for now. It has been performing well and aligns with our overall investment strategy.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Sofia Schmidt
transcript_excerpt.text: That's a good point, Mary. However, I also think it would be beneficial to explore new opportunities in alternative investments to enhance portfolio diversification.
